note: Expected links between frameworks, used by the combined profile. A rule is read only when its anchor dimension is pronounced (level 'high'). If the other side is at the expected level the frameworks resonate; if it is at the opposite level they differ; a middle level says nothing. Neither side is treated as the truth: a difference is information about the person, not an error in one test. Levels: Likert dimensions use their bands; Guna and Prakriti use shares (high >= 40%, low <= 26%); Vikriti uses ticks (high >= 3, low <= 1).

rules.resonate: The heaviness Guna picks up shows in your personality profile too, as emotional reactivity. Both point to the same thing: steadying the nervous system is where to begin.
rules.differ: Guna shows strong Tamas, yet your personality profile is emotionally steady. The heaviness may be more about energy and routine than mood.

rules.resonate: Tamas and a looser relationship with structure show up together. A small, fixed daily routine serves both.
rules.differ: Guna shows strong Tamas, but you are highly conscientious. You may be keeping everything running while feeling heavy inside, which is worth noticing before it becomes exhaustion.

rules.resonate: Sattva's discipline and your conscientiousness describe the same steady follow-through from two directions.
rules.differ: Sattva is strong, yet structure and routine aren't a strong pull in your personality. Your clarity may come more from inner contentment than from order.

rules.resonate: The equanimity of Sattva matches an emotionally steady personality.
rules.differ: Sattva is strong, and you also feel things intensely. Equanimity here may be something you practise and return to rather than a default, which is what practice is for.

rules.resonate: Rajas' drive and your outgoing energy go together: you are fuelled by activity and people.
rules.differ: Rajas is strong, but you are reserved socially. The restlessness is probably inward (goals, thoughts, striving) rather than social.

rules.resonate: Vata's mobility shows up in your personality as quick, strong reactions. Grounding (routine, warmth, slow breath) serves both.
rules.differ: Your constitution leans Vata, yet you are emotionally steady. Your Vata may express more through creativity and movement than through worry.

rules.resonate: Vata's quick, creative mind and your openness to ideas describe the same imaginative streak.
rules.differ: Your constitution leans Vata, but you prefer the practical and proven. Your Vata may show more in the body and energy than in ideas.

rules.resonate: Pitta's focus and drive match your conscientiousness: sharp, goal-directed and thorough. Watch for perfectionism in both.
rules.differ: Your constitution leans Pitta, but structure isn't a strong pull for you. Pitta's intensity may go into passion and debate more than planning.

rules.resonate: Kapha's steadiness shows up as emotional stability in your personality: you are hard to knock off balance.
rules.differ: Your constitution leans Kapha, yet you feel stress strongly at the moment. Check your Vikriti: a current Vata or Pitta imbalance often explains this.

rules.resonate: Kapha's loyalty and patience match your warmth towards others.
rules.differ: Your constitution leans Kapha, but you are direct rather than accommodating. Your Kapha may show more as endurance than as softness.

rules.resonate: The worry you feel in relationships is part of a wider sensitivity to stress, so general regulation practices help your relationships too.
rules.differ: You worry in close relationships but are steady elsewhere. The worry is specific to closeness, which makes it easier to work on directly.

rules.resonate: Keeping distance in relationships fits your independent, direct style more generally.
rules.differ: You are warm towards people in general, yet keep partners at a distance. Closeness may feel safe in friendship but riskier in romance.

rules.resonate: Current Kapha imbalance and Tamas both point to heaviness right now. Energising practice and lighter food address both.
rules.differ: Kapha is raised in your body, but your mind isn't heavy. Address the physical side (movement, lighter food) before it spreads.

rules.resonate: Current Pitta imbalance and Rajas both point to running hot: intensity, pressure and pushing. Cooling, non-competitive practice helps both.
rules.differ: Pitta is raised in your body, but your mind isn't especially driven. The heat may come from outside (season, food, workload) rather than ambition.

rules.resonate: Current Vata imbalance and emotional reactivity go hand in hand: grounding routine, warmth and slow breathing help both.
rules.differ: Vata is raised right now, though you are emotionally steady by nature. That makes it likely a passing imbalance: travel, irregular sleep or the season.
